rule: Each figure has a short NE arrow and a long arrow whose tip touches one tick on the border. Numbering border ticks clockwise (top-mid, top-right, right-upper, right-mid, right-lower), the touched tick goes top-mid, right-upper, top-right, right-mid, i.e. two interleaved sequences each moving one tick clockwise per step (odd: top-mid, top-right, right-upper; even: right-upper, right-mid, right-lower). Figure 5 therefore has its long arrow touching the right-upper tick.
options_check:
1: single NE arrow touching top-right tick, repeats figure 3, no.
2: long arrow to right-lower tick, that is the 6th figure, no.
3: long arrow to right-mid tick, repeats figure 4, no.
4: long arrow up to top-mid tick, repeats figure 1, no.
5: long arrow to right-upper tick, short NE arrow kept, fits the odd sequence step.
redraw_diffs: Redraw matches arrows and tick-touch positions closely; only minor tick offsets and arrow length differences, none that change the answer.
